data.title: Celebrate the Season in War Robots: Frontiers!
data.summary: Festive Events, Frosty Rewards, and Holiday Cheer Await
data.meta_title: Celebrate the Season in War Robots: Frontiers!
data.meta_description: Festive Events, Frosty Rewards, and Holiday Cheer Await
data.content:
The holiday lights are glowing, the snow is falling across Tortuga, and it’s time to celebrate the most wonderful time of the year with a sleighload of festive activities in War Robots: Frontiers!

From daily login rewards to creative contests and generous giveaways, this winter season is packed with reasons to jump into battle and spread some holiday cheer.

Winter Wonderland Discord Giveaway (December 17-24)

We're kicking off the festivities with a frosty treat for our community! Join our Discord and head to the #community-events channel to enter the Winter Wonderland Giveaway. Winners will be randomly selected on December 24. 

Ten lucky Pilots will each receive a powerful holiday resource pack, including:

  • 10,000 Salvage
  • 10,000 Credits
  • 3 Days of Premium

Get ready to dominate the battlefield this holiday season!

Cryo Gift Calendar (December 23-29)

Just like a real advent calendar, the magic is in the mystery! Each day brings a new surprise that stays wrapped until the moment it’s revealed. The only way to find out what’s inside is to log in and play!

Complete one battle per day to unwrap up to seven festive rewards as they’re revealed day by day.

Daily Rewards Schedule:

  • Dec 23 (09:00-23:59 UTC): Secret Gift
  • Dec 24 (00:00-23:59 UTC): Secret Gift
  • Dec 25 (00:00-23:59 UTC): Secret Gift
  • Dec 26 (00:00-23:59 UTC): Secret Gift
  • Dec 27 (00:00-23:59 UTC): Secret Gift
  • Dec 28 (00:00-23:59 UTC): Secret Gift
  • Dec 29 (00:00-23:59 UTC): Secret Gift

How to Participate:

  • Complete your Training Battles to qualify.
  • Play 1 battle and claim rewards as you go.
  • Rewards can only be claimed on their respective days—miss a day, and the gift is gone!

Don’t let the Grinch steal your loot, log in daily and unwrap the holiday magic!

Note: Some Secret Gifts will also be available in the in-game Store for Pilots who miss a day or don’t want to wait to add them to their roster.

Battle Bonus Event: Frostline Unlock! (December 30 - January 12)

Close out the year and start the new one with another festive login event! Log in and complete three battles per day to unlock stylish cosmetics and valuable resources.

Daily Rewards:

  • Day 1: Grizzly Paint, 50 Intel
  • Day 2: 10,000 Salvage
  • Day 3: Arctic Paint, 50 Intel
  • Day 4: 10,000 Salvage
  • Day 5: Rose Quartz Paint,  50 Intel
  • Day 6: 10,000 Salvage
  • Day 7: Shiny Armor Wrap, 50 Intel

How to Participate:

  • Complete your Training Battles to qualify.
  • Play 3 battles and claim rewards as you go.
  • You must receive the previous reward to be eligible for the next one (you can’t skip rewards).

Winter Build & Art Contest (December 29 - January 12)

It’s time to unleash your creativity! Give your Hangar a seasonal makeover with icy decorations, snowy aesthetics, or winter-themed War Robots.

How to Participate:

  • Join our Discord.
  • From December 29 until January 12, share a screenshot of your winter-themed Hangar in the special #frostfall-showcase channel, along with your in-game name.
  • Receive 15,000 Salvage just for participating!

The War Robots: Frontiers team will select 5 standout entries to receive a massive 50,000 Salvage reward.

Get creative, get frosty, and show us your fiercest winter designs!

A Season to Remember

Whether you’re battling for daily rewards, showing off your artistic flair, or scoring big in our Discord giveaways, this holiday season in War Robots: Frontiers is packed with warmth, excitement, and explosive fun.

From all of us on the War Robots: Frontiers team—happy holidays, and we’ll see you on the battlefield!
